description: This file contains the implementation of the ImageIndex class and related functions for handling texture image indices in the ANGLE graphics library. It defines methods for creating, comparing, and iterating over image indices for various texture types.

classes.name: ImageIndex
classes.description: Represents a specific image within a texture, including type, level, layer, and count.

classes.name: ImageIndexIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing image indices over mipmap levels, layers, and texture types.

methods.name: TextureTargetToLayer
methods.description: Converts a TextureTarget enum to a layer index.

methods.name: IsArrayTarget
methods.description: Checks if a TextureTarget is an array type.

methods.name: TextureTypeToTarget
methods.description: Converts a TextureType and layer index to a TextureTarget.

methods.name: ImageIndex::ImageIndex
methods.description: Default constructor for ImageIndex.

methods.name: ImageIndex::hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if the image index has a specific layer.

methods.name: ImageIndex::isLayered
methods.description: Checks if the image index represents a layered texture.

methods.name: ImageIndex::has3DLayer
methods.description: Checks if the image index has a 3D layer.

methods.name: ImageIndex::usesTex3D
methods.description: Determines if the texture type uses 3D textures.

methods.name: ImageIndex::getTarget
methods.description: Returns the TextureTarget corresponding to the image index.

methods.name: ImageIndex::getTargetOrFirstCubeFace
methods.description: Returns the target or the first cube face target if entire level cube map.

methods.name: ImageIndex::cubeMapFaceIndex
methods.description: Returns the face index for cube map textures.

methods.name: ImageIndex::valid
methods.description: Checks if the image index is valid.

methods.name: ImageIndex::isEntireLevelCubeMap
methods.description: Checks if the image index is an entire level cube map.

methods.name: ImageIndex::Make2D
methods.description: Creates a 2D image index at a specific mip level.

methods.name: ImageIndex::MakeRectangle
methods.description: Creates a rectangle texture image index.

methods.name: ImageIndex::MakeCubeMapFace
methods.description: Creates a cube map face image index.

methods.name: ImageIndex::Make2DArray
methods.description: Creates a 2D array texture image index.

methods.name: ImageIndex::Make2DArrayRange
methods.description: Creates a range of layers in a 2D array texture.

methods.name: ImageIndex::Make3D
methods.description: Creates a 3D texture image index.

methods.name: ImageIndex::MakeFromTarget
methods.description: Creates an image index from a TextureTarget.

methods.name: ImageIndex::MakeFromType
methods.description: Creates an image index from a TextureType, level, layer, and count.

methods.name: ImageIndex::Make2DMultisample
methods.description: Creates a multisample 2D image index.

methods.name: ImageIndex::Make2DMultisampleArray
methods.description: Creates a multisample 2D array image index.

methods.name: ImageIndex::Make2DMultisampleArrayRange
methods.description: Creates a range of layers in a multisample 2D array.

methods.name: ImageIndex::operator<
methods.description: Less-than comparison operator for ImageIndex.

methods.name: ImageIndex::operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for ImageIndex.

methods.name: ImageIndex::operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for ImageIndex.

methods.name: ImageIndex::getLayerIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over layers for the image index.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::Make2D
methods.description: Creates an iterator for 2D textures over mip levels.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::MakeRectangle
methods.description: Creates an iterator for rectangle textures.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::MakeCube
methods.description: Creates an iterator for cube map textures.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::Make3D
methods.description: Creates an iterator for 3D textures.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::Make2DArray
methods.description: Creates an iterator for 2D array textures.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::Make2DMultisample
methods.description: Creates an iterator for multisample 2D textures.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::Make2DMultisampleArray
methods.description: Creates an iterator for multisample 2D array textures.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::MakeGeneric
methods.description: Creates a generic iterator for a given texture type, mip, and layer ranges.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::maxLayer
methods.description: Returns the maximum layer index for the current iterator position.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next image index.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::current
methods.description: Returns the current image index.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator::hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more image indices to iterate over.
